newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade brisk at $68, up $1.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade brisk at $68, up $1.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle near midday sold at $68.00 per cwt in active trading, up $1.00 from sales Thursday and Friday and unchanged from the bulk of last week's sales, feedlot sources and USDA confirmed.
About 10,000 head had sold in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area and about 5,000 in Kansas, but amounts were expected to grow as the day progressed, sources said.
"I sold my entire showlist at $68.00," one Panhandle feedyard manager said.
